## Recovery synthesis

The generic contract already explains what a numerical method must declare.
The historical record identifies a candidate procedure, including consequential
choices that the label “FRUIT” hides. It does not settle their scientific merit.
The proposal therefore asks for one observation/raw JINC method scope while
leaving the numerical choice and every absent binding explicit.

Three gaps matter most. First, an exact original-observation/RTC/residual-PTC/
rejoined-signal/JINC route needs compatible producer permissions; ordinary
PTC output admission alone does not answer the rejoin handoff. Second,
historical selection may consume RMS, weight and kernel companions outside
JINC's fixed base bundle. Third, actual control inputs, ordered configuration,
executable/environment and complete causal state have not been bound here.
None can be filled by naming an old default or declaring an optional role zero.

The remaining scientific work is exact method choice and upstream boundary
closure. The [sanitized scope](author/SCOPE_BRIEF.md) carries those questions
without historical numerical answers. Its [reference proposal](PROPOSED_AUTHOR_REFERENCES.md)
requires exact owner approval before any fresh author. The internal dossier,
method recovery table and copied manager inputs cannot enter that channel.
